tasks.label: EsmatPlastic: Start API
tasks.command: $apiListener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5023 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($apiListener) { try { $health = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:5023/api/health/status' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; if ($health.status -eq 'Healthy') { Write-Output 'Now listening on: http://localhost:5023 (reusing healthy API)'; exit 0 } } catch {}; throw 'Port 5023 is already in use by an unhealthy or unrelated service.' }; $envFile = '.env.local'; Get-Content $envFile | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^(.*?)=(.*)$') { $name = $matches[1].Trim(); $value = $matches[2].Trim('\"'); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $value, 'Process') } }; dotnet run --project 'EsmatPlastic.API/EsmatPlastic.API.csproj' -p:BaseOutputPath=bin\VSCodeTask\

tasks.label: EsmatPlastic: Start Desktop
tasks.command: $desktopProcess = Get-Process -Name 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($desktopProcess) { Write-Output '__ESMATPLASTIC_DESKTOP_READY__'; Wait-Process -Id $desktopProcess.Id; exit 0 }; dotnet build 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop/EsmatPlastic.Desktop.csproj'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $desktopPath = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop/bin/Debug/net9.0-windows/EsmatPlastic.Desktop.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $desktopPath)) { throw 'Desktop executable was not produced by the build.' }; $desktopProcess = Start-Process -FilePath $desktopPath -WorkingDirectory (Join-Path (Get-Location) 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop') -PassThru; Write-Output '__ESMATPLASTIC_DESKTOP_READY__'; Wait-Process -Id $desktopProcess.Id

tasks.label: EsmatPlastic: Ensure Android Emulator
tasks.command: $adb = 'C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $adb)) { throw 'Android adb.exe was not found.' }; $onlineDevice = & $adb devices | Select-String '\s+device$' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $onlineDevice) { $emulatorProcesses = Get-Process -Name emulator -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($emulatorProcesses) { & $adb reconnect offline | Out-Null } else { $emulator = 'C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\emulator\emulator.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $emulator)) { throw 'Android emulator.exe was not found.' }; Start-Process -FilePath $emulator -ArgumentList @('-avd', 'Medium_Phone') -WindowStyle Normal }; $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(3); do { $onlineDevice = & $adb devices | Select-String '\s+device$' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $onlineDevice) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } } while (-not $onlineDevice -and [DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline) }; if (-not $onlineDevice) { throw 'No Android device connected. The Medium_Phone emulator did not come online.' }; $serial = $onlineDevice.Line.Split()[0]; $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(3); $bootCompleted = ''; do { $bootCompleted = (& $adb -s $serial shell getprop sys.boot_completed | Out-String).Trim(); if ($bootCompleted -ne '1') { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } } while ($bootCompleted -ne '1' -and [DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline); if ($bootCompleted -ne '1') { throw ('Android target ' + $serial + ' did not finish booting.') }; Write-Output ('Android target ' + $serial + ' is ready.')

tasks.label: EsmatPlastic: Start Mobile Android
tasks.command: $project = 'EsmatPlastic.Mobile/EsmatPlastic.Mobile.csproj'; dotnet build $project -f net9.0-android; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $adb = 'C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $adb)) { throw 'Android adb.exe was not found.' }; $onlineDevice = & $adb devices | Select-String '\s+device$' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $onlineDevice) { throw 'No online Android device or emulator is connected.' }; $serial = $onlineDevice.Line.Split()[0]; $apk = Get-ChildItem 'EsmatPlastic.Mobile/bin/Debug/net9.0-android' -Filter 'com.esmatplastic.mobile-Signed.apk' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $apk) { throw 'Signed Android APK was not found.' }; & $adb -s $serial install -r $apk.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $adb -s $serial shell monkey -p com.esmatplastic.mobile -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1; exit $LASTEXITCODE
